title: Add a product
prompt: Add one product: id 25, name Desk Lamp, category_id 9, price 35.00, stock 12, added_on 2025-02-01. Leave the other columns to their defaults.
hints: Which columns are you giving a value, and in what order?
List those columns after the table name, then the values in the same order.
INSERT INTO products (id, name, category_id, price, stock, added_on) VALUES (25, 'Desk Lamp', 9, 35.00, 12, '2025-02-01');
verify: SELECT id, name, category_id, price, stock, discontinued, added_on FROM products WHERE id >= 24 ORDER BY id;

wrongAnswers.misconception: Leaves out a column that must have a value.
Gives the values in a different order from the columns.

feedback: Match each value with the column in the same position of the column list.
